purpose: clarify signed contrast extraction and NA handling; no changes to thresholds, methods or evaluator
paired_difference_orientation: For requested A-minus-B use row A,B as recorded; if only row B,A exists, negate difference and reverse/negate interval endpoints: lower=-old_upper,upper=-old_lower.
Public_contrast_example: Stored P_only_hgb-minus-Learned_hgb must be reversed for Learned_hgb-minus-P_only_hgb.
finite_requirement: Both original context metrics, macro point and both paired CI endpoints must be finite; NA/nonfinite means NOT_ESTABLISHED, not a passing guard. Do not omit invalid original contexts.
minimum_original_tasks_not_sufficient: n>=20 is necessary; it cannot rescue U20 denominator<=1e-12, missing historical coverage or invalid intervals.
registry_status: New dated pretruth interpretation, not original McFaline preregistration and not an executable evaluator PASS gate.
